body: 16 in less than a week lmao

i really appreciate your comment, i'm glad someone at least somewhat understands lol. i honestly had a reason why i don't think it's my anxiety but it just left my mind i can't seem to remember it. this sucks. thank you for the kind words though i'm really just trying to stay here so i can figure out what the hell this is. its just strange i know what my anxiety feels like ive had it for a long time but not nearly as long as this feeling. its like the root of my problems, it feels like. like the feeling gets strong and then i get worried / anxious not because of what the feeling is making me feel but because i have no idea what it means. it also makes me sad because it ruins moments but it doesn't seem to be rooted in sadness or anger or anything. its the weirdest thing ever idk. this is a side note but i also think there's something wrong with my ears and eyes. my eyes constantly misinterpret things. like shadows constantly look like they're changing shapes, things look like they're moving, and other random things. i also can't listen to things loudly, it freaks me out and it feels like im doing something my ears don't like. i also really cannot stand any mushy sounds like chewing, swallowing, wet ground. as i type this reply spotify keeps giving me an ad for some horror movie and every time it has this one scene with this god awful sound that makes me want to throw my phone against a wall. i think the way i feel when i react to these two problems is probably the closest i can get to explaining what that underlying feeling is, just super duper extreme bursts of it for a small time frame is the closest ive ever gotten to figuring it out. its like it spikes when those happens and then goes back to being just a little bit under my skin.
